content:
Talia Benson: GA enablement window for hot-route capacity protection starting now (per release train). Goal: flip flags globally (Hosted API + Dedicated) w/ enterprise route protections.

Checklist for go/no-go:
- us-east + eu-west canaries clean (allowlist)
- SRE dashboards green (enterprise p95/p99 + 5xx + shed rate)
- no metric cardinality regressions
- rollback plan confirmed

Links:
- Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/hosted-hot-routes-ga
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/runbook-overload-protection-and-admission-control
- Launch checklist: https://drive.google.com/redwood/launch-checklist-hot-route-capacity-protection

Benji Okafor: Flags queued for stepwise rollout:
1) `hot_route_protection.gateway_enforce=true`
2) `hot_route_protection.routing_admission=true`
3) `hot_route_protection.fallback_guardrails=true`

Order: us-east -> eu-west -> us-west. 10 min soak between steps, 30 min between regions.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout job `rrt-flagflip-5271` (env=prod)
- region=us-east
- flags=hot_route_protection.gateway_enforce,hot_route_protection.routing_admission,hot_route_protection.fallback_guardrails
- allowlist=acme-ai,proxima-bank (enterprise)

Amara Diallo: Gateway side looks good in canary since yesterday. 429 schema is stable + headers present.
Quick reminder: if we see customers complaining about “random 429s”, check `x-redwood-throttle-reason` first.
Expected values: `quota_exceeded`, `rate_limited`, `overload_shed`.

Sergio Costa: Looking at dashboard now. us-east canary last 30m:
- enterprise chat p95: 480-520ms (flat)
- enterprise 5xx: 0.02%
- best-effort shed rate: spikes to ~6% during the top-of-hour burst (expected)
- queue depth: elevated but stable
No burn alerts firing.

Rafael Mendes: :thumbsup: SRE perspective: canary behaves like game day. Shedding is happening early on best-effort, enterprise stays within SLO.
If we cross enterprise 5xx > 0.3% for 5m OR p99 > SLO for 10m, we roll back routing admission first.

Mina Haddad: Routing admission control is in “tier-first” mode (best-effort gated first). Confirming capacity signals are coming through.
For reference, current gating thresholds us-east:
- `scheduler_lag_ms > 250` for 60s OR
- `queue_depth > 1.2x baseline` for 90s

Vanessa Ortiz: Fleet signals look sane; GPU saturation peaked ~92% but didn’t pin. No “sawtooth” autoscaling behavior.

Talia Benson: Great. Waiting for 10 min soak then moving allowlist -> broader in us-east.

deploy-bot: Rollout step complete: us-east allowlist enabled
- `hot_route_protection.gateway_enforce=true`
- `hot_route_protection.routing_admission=true`
- `hot_route_protection.fallback_guardrails=true`
Status: SUCCESS

Benji Okafor: Proceeding to us-east 25% traffic (non-allowlist), still excluding a few legacy tenants (list in launch checklist).

incident-bot: FYI: Overload protection activated (region=us-east, route_group=chat_completions)
- tier=best_effort
- shed_rate=7.8% (5m)
- reason=capacity_signal_queue_depth
Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/hosted-hot-routes-ga?var-region=us-east
Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/runbook-overload-protection-and-admission-control

Owen Phillips: Noted. No inbound support pings yet. I’m watching #support for any “429 spike” reports.

Sergio Costa: Saw the incident-bot message. Enterprise line stayed flat during that shed spike. Burn rate is fine.
Also confirming no unexpected tag explosion in `overload_event_total` (we had that regression last month). Cardinality looks bounded.

Rafael Mendes: :white_check_mark: This is what we want—signal triggers + controlled shedding with enterprise protected.
Proceed.

Talia Benson: Moving to eu-west canary region now.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout job `rrt-flagflip-5272` (env=prod)
- region=eu-west
- flags=hot_route_protection.gateway_enforce,hot_route_protection.routing_admission,hot_route_protection.fallback_guardrails
- allowlist=acme-ai,proxima-bank (enterprise)

Irene Choi: Heads up: eu-west has tighter headroom (capacity forecast doc). If queue depth ramps, expect earlier best-effort throttling.

Mina Haddad: eu-west routing config includes slightly lower threshold per infra notes:
- `scheduler_lag_ms > 220` OR `queue_depth > 1.1x`
This is intentional.

Sergio Costa: eu-west canary first 10m:
- enterprise embeddings p95: 95-110ms (ok)
- enterprise chat p95: 610-680ms (a bit higher than us-east but within eu-west target)
- 429 rate for best-effort: ~3% and rising
Nothing alarming.

Amara Diallo: Quick sanity check from gateway logs eu-west:
- 429 payload includes `reason=overload_shed` and `retry_after_ms` set
- we’re not seeing mixed 429/503 like the legacy throttle path used to do

Benji Okafor: eu-west soak completes in ~8m. If green, we go 25% then 100% in region.

Rafael Mendes: Watching p99 + 5xx on enterprise. So far clean. Also keep an eye on streaming termination metrics (we had SUP-18462).

Sergio Costa: Streaming terminations look normal: `stream_end_reason=overload_shed` is present when it happens; no “hung streams” spike.

deploy-bot: Rollout step complete: eu-west allowlist enabled
Status: SUCCESS

Talia Benson: Proceeding to eu-west 25%.

deploy-bot: Rollout step complete: eu-west 25% enabled
Status: SUCCESS

Vanessa Ortiz: Fleet side eu-west: GPU utilization stable at 80-88%. No saturation alarms.

Sergio Costa: eu-west 25% looks good. Enterprise SLOs holding, 5xx flat.
Best-effort 429 increased ~5-6% during a burst but latency stayed sane (so the gate is doing its job).

Ethan Park: Platform sign-off from me if SRE is satisfied. Enforcement points behaving as designed (gateway + routing). No unexpected latency overhead in policy eval (p50 flat).

Rafael Mendes: SRE sign-off. We’re meeting the protection goals: enterprise stays green during pressure, best-effort gets predictable 429s.
Recommend proceeding to us-west + then global 100%.

Talia Benson: Acknowledged. Rolling into us-west.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout job `rrt-flagflip-5273` (env=prod)
- region=us-west
- flags=hot_route_protection.gateway_enforce,hot_route_protection.routing_admission,hot_route_protection.fallback_guardrails
- allowlist=acme-ai,proxima-bank (enterprise)

Benji Okafor: us-west will be shorter soak (traffic lower). Same rollback: disable routing admission first, then gateway enforcement if needed.
Rollback commands (runbook has full details):
`rrctl flags set hot_route_protection.routing_admission=false --region us-west`
`rrctl flags set hot_route_protection.gateway_enforce=false --region us-west`

incident-bot: FYI: Overload protection activated (region=eu-west, route_group=embeddings)
- tier=best_effort
- shed_rate=4.1% (5m)
- reason=capacity_signal_scheduler_lag

Sergio Costa: eu-west alert is FYI-only, not paging (as configured). Enterprise embeddings unaffected.

deploy-bot: Rollout step complete: us-west allowlist enabled
Status: SUCCESS

Sergio Costa: us-west canary quick check: all green.

Talia Benson: Moving to global 100% (all regions) now. Last call for objections.

Rafael Mendes: No objections.

Ethan Park: Good to go.

deploy-bot: Rollout step complete: prod global enabled
- regions=us-east,us-west,eu-west
- flags=hot_route_protection.gateway_enforce=true,hot_route_protection.routing_admission=true,hot_route_protection.fallback_guardrails=true
Status: SUCCESS

Talia Benson: GA enablement complete. Monitoring for 60m; please keep an eye on dashboards + #incidents for any anomalies. If stable, we’ll close out the release checklist and hand off to normal on-call.

Owen Phillips: I’ll post a quick note to Support with what “expected” looks like for 429 volume + the reason codes to quote.

Rafael Mendes: Thanks all. If we stay green through the top-of-hour, we can declare done.

Sergio Costa: 30m post-GA: enterprise p95 stable, 5xx stable, burn rate normal. Best-effort 429 elevated but consistent + correlated w/ capacity signals (no surprises).

Talia Benson: Marking release as successful barring any late regression. Closing out.
